The drop zone's dots in motion

Four ways the dots could move, each in dark and in light (L6: L5’s band, L1’s drop zone). Every frame is drawn by the drop zone’s own colour arithmetic and played at the rate the app would redraw: 15 a second, as the header bar’s drift does. All four loop for as long as home is idle. A dot rests at 0.5 (by the words) to 0.9 (at the edges) of the way from the panel to its colour; the motion lifts it by at most 0.3 — 0.5 to 0.8 for the faintest — and never past its own colour, so no dot grows or turns white. Only the dots move; the words, the cut-out and the field never do. With motion off — NO_COLOR, the first-run palette, a pipe — every one of these is the still screen you have today.
